authoring.rationale: The activity log is written by the service and only read by clients.
Boards reorder columns and cards concurrently through keyed sequences.
Notes are edited concurrently; every field declares how concurrent edits merge.
Replication health is reported by replicas and reset by operators.
Tasks are saved whole against the revision they were read at.
Workspace settings change only through explicit commands.
